name: Peak Limiter
purpose: Transparent lookahead peak limiter with true-peak detection; the final safety stage that holds the output under the ceiling.

latency.note: Lookahead latency reported to the host through the 'latency' output port.

params.name: Input Gain
params.ai_hint: Drives the signal into the limiter. Keep at 0-3 dB unless loudness is requested; upstream allows +30 dB.

params.name: Threshold
params.ai_hint: Output ceiling. Plugsalot never allows above -1 dB.

params.name: Release Time
params.ai_hint: Release time in seconds; 0.01 s default, longer for smoother limiting.

params.name: True Peak
params.ai_hint: Keep on so inter-sample peaks are caught.

hidden_params.reason: The enable port is driven by Plugsalot's own bypass.

notes: The validator places this module last in any chain and allows only one.
Release has no unit in the Turtle file; x42 documents it in seconds.
